precision_proof: Inputs <=24 digits, scale -6..12: aligned exact sums <=43 digits, products <=48, requested quotient coefficient <=56 digits. prec160 prevents intermediate add/sub/mul rounding (Inexact trapped/asserted). Every div/rescale quantize is separately certified by exact rational q,r,d; no double rounding can survive the certificate. rust_decimal native division is corroboration only, independently certified against the same rational boundary.
